I / me (polite, neutral): like that / so / in that way

I / me (polite, neutral): what's it called (stalling for a word)
Itu, apa namanya, yang di dapur.

I / me (polite, neutral): right / so — marks the point you've been building to

Okay, I'll let you know.

I / me (polite, neutral): father — also "sir" to an older man
